name: Leshy, Flytrap
body:
FLYTRAP LESHY
CR 5

This cluster of flytraps has a vaguely humanoid shape. The beady eyes atop the largest flytrap glare menacingly. An air of barely constrained anger surrounds this walking bundle of fanged leaves.

XP 1,600
CN Medium plant (leshy)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)
hp 59 (7d8+28)
Fort +8, Ref +6, Will +4
Immune electricity, plant traits, sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 3 bites +7 (1d6+2)
Ranged acid spit +7 touch (1d6 acid)
Special Attacks renewed vigor, sap rage, verdant channel 3/day (4d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +6)

At-Will—tree shape (small flytrap only)
Constant—pass without trace, speak with plants

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 15, Con 16, Int 9, Wis 15, Cha 8
Base Atk +5; CMB +7; CMD 20
Feats Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness
Skills Intimidate +6, Stealth +2 (+6 Stealth in forest), Survival +2 (+6 Survival in forest); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth and Survival in forests
Languages Common, Druidic, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Acid Spit (Ex)

Acid spit is a ranged touch attack which has a range increment of 20 feet and deals 1d6 acid damage.

Renewed Vigor (Ex)

While sap raging, a flytrap leshy can take a standard action to heal 2d8 points of damage + its Constitution modifier. This ability may only be used once per day.

Sap Rage (Ex)

When a flytrap leshy takes damage, as an immediate action it can fly into a sap rage for one round. While in a sap rage, Cruncher gains a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and a 10-foot enhancement bonus to its base speed, but takes a –2 penalty to its AC.

Verdant Channel (Ex)

A flytrap leshy can channel verdant energy to a range of 30 feet. This acts as channel positive energy, but it can only heal plant creatures and deals no damage to undead.
